testcase.name: Scenario: Stage the same command on two ribbon targets: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:499:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Stage the same command on two ribbon targets ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Part Tools and Part Manage custom panel lists are initially empty ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows Part Tools and All Commands ✔ When the user adds "2D Sketches" to the Part Tools custom panel ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the Part Tools custom panel list ✔ And "2D Sketches" is absent from the visible available commands list ✔ When the user selects the Part Manage target ✔ Then its custom panel list is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list ✔ When the user adds "2D Sketches" to the Part Manage custom panel ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the Part Manage custom panel list ✔ And the target indicates a pending change ✔ When the user returns to the Part Tools target ✔ Then "2D Sketches" remains in its custom panel list ✔ And the target indicates a pending change ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel is displayed on the Tools ribbon
